# Noto Sans KR

The game UI uses the unmodified official Noto Sans KR variable font at weight 600. All text, native Button input behavior, and existing font sizes are retained. Glyph metrics intentionally differ from the previous engine font and OS fallback mixture.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr

Captured 2026-10-11 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/notosanskr/NotoSansKR%5Bwght%5D.ttf . Upstream main can change; this release is pinned by the following file hash.

- `assets/fonts/NotoSansKR-wght.ttf`: 10,414,588 bytes, SHA-256 `194018e6b2b293a7964f037b25c0249ce1418bc9ab3c971060a03aa57861e252`
- `assets/fonts/NotoSansKR-OFL.txt`: original copyright and SIL Open Font License 1.1, SHA-256 `1c05c68c34f9708415aada51f17e1b0092d2cea709bf4a94cd38114f9e73d7d9`

The copyright and license are shipped in the game package alongside the font. The font is not modified, renamed, or sold on its own. Only these two exact asset paths are admitted by the production export filter; candidate and unrelated font files are excluded.

The font adds about 5.35 MB at ZIP deflate level 6 in an isolated compression estimate. This is not an APK size measurement. Host headless timing is not Android performance evidence.
